Subject: Request to open GRC Security Engineer (IC4) - urgent hire

Marissa,

I'm requesting approval to open a full-time headcount for a GRC-focused Security Engineer (IC4) to support SOC2 program expansion and vendor risk automation. Summary: 1) Role will own GRC automation (policy-as-code, auditor workflows), 2) Partner closely with InfoSec and Platform to remediate continuous monitoring gaps, 3) Immediate need because we have two upcoming audits and the current workload exceeds the team capacity.

Impact if not approved: audit prep delays, increased consultant spend, potential compliance escalations. Requested start: target onboard by mid-April.

Attachments: GRC_Security_Lead_JD.pdf, Headcount_Request_Form.docx

Please advise on compensation band and whether finance can approve as headcount increase or if we need to reallocate a contractor spot. Happy to hop on a quick call.

Thanks,
Hiro
Hiro Tanaka
Director, Security Engineering

Date: 2026-02-26T08:47:00Z
Subject: Comp band recommendation: GRC Security Engineer (IC4)

Hi all,

Thanks for sharing the JD — attached is a short comp benchmarking note and the Q1 band spreadsheet (Comp_Bands_Q1_2026.xlsx). Short summary for IC4 / Senior Security Engineer focused on GRC at a mid-stage infra company in SF/remote-US:
- Market median base: $170,000
- 25th–75th base range: $155,000 — $185,000
- Typical sign-on range: $5,000 — $20,000 (higher for counteroffers)
- Equity: 0.04% — 0.08% RSU-equivalent over 4 years (company dependent)

Recommended internal band we can approve today: base $160k — $180k, sign-on cap $15k, target offer at $165k base for strong mid-market candidates. Methodology: blended comp across cloud infra and security-focused startups, adjusted for our current burn profile.

Attachment: Comp_Bands_Q1_2026.xlsx

Happy to join a quick sync if you want to talk nuance.

—Kelly Byrne
Senior Consultant, CompBench
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Hiro Tanaka <hiro.tanaka@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-01T10:12:00Z
Subject: Re: Approval: GRC Security Engineer headcount & offer band

Marissa — reviewed comp note and headcount form. Finance can approve the headcount under two scenarios:

1) Cost-neutral: convert an open contractor line (SRE contractor currently unfilled) to FTE — approved.
2) Net-new headcount: requires incremental budget approval; we can approve up to $180k base if the hiring manager secures an offset or if execs approve a one-time FY delta.

Recommendation for initial offer to move recruiting quickly: base $165,000, sign-on $10,000 (cap), expected OTE ~190k including 4-year equity target. Please update Headcount_Request_Form.docx to indicate whether you will reallocate the contractor.

Attachment: Headcount_Request_Form.docx (updated, with budget notes)

Vivek Kulkarni
Director, Finance — Go-to-market & Platform
Redwood Inference

Subject: Approved: GRC Security Engineer hire — prepare offer for candidate Samuel Reid

Team — moving forward. Finance has cleared the role contingent on converting the open SRE contractor (cost-neutral). We will proceed with the following offer parameters for the candidate currently in final loop (Samuel Reid):

- Role: GRC Security Engineer (IC4)
- Base: $165,000
- Sign-on: $10,000 (one-time)
- Equity: standard mid-stage RSU package (to be filled by comp team)
- Target start date: 2026-04-14
- Conditions: standard background check and signed employee NDA; role requires participation in security onboarding and access control training before prod access.

Greenfield Partners — please prepare the formal offer and include the background-check link and the DocuSign offer packet. Copy format used by our recruiting team here: https://greenhouse.io/jobs/rdw-12345. Neha, Vivek — please confirm equity sizing and any final payroll notes.

Marissa
VP, Product & Platform Operations
